sources.title: Construction Design and Management Regulations 2015
sources.verified_claim: CDM 2015 applies health-and-safety duties across construction projects from concept to completion; regulatory duties do not establish candidate-project compliance.

sources.title: Commercial clients roles and responsibilities
sources.verified_claim: Commercial clients must arrange competent management of construction risks and appoint required dutyholders; no candidate client structure is inferred.

sources.title: Principal contractors roles and responsibilities
sources.verified_claim: Principal contractors plan, manage, monitor and coordinate the construction phase and maintain a construction phase plan; this is role guidance, not candidate status.

sources.title: Are you a principal designer?
sources.verified_claim: A principal designer leads pre-construction health-and-safety coordination on multi-contractor projects; appointment depends on actual project arrangements.

sources.title: F10 Notification of Construction Project
sources.verified_claim: Notifiable projects require an F10 notification by the appropriate dutyholder; notification is not planning permission, building-control approval or evidence that a candidate project exists.

sources.title: Arrange an asbestos survey
sources.verified_claim: Management and refurbishment/demolition surveys have different purposes; major refurbishment or demolition requires intrusive identification of asbestos-containing materials where applicable.

sources.title: Check if you have the duty to manage asbestos
sources.verified_claim: The duty to manage applies to non-domestic premises and common parts of multi-occupancy domestic premises, with responsibility depending on ownership and maintenance arrangements.

sources.title: HSE inspectors checking asbestos management
sources.verified_claim: HSE's 2026 inspection campaign reiterates survey, register, management-plan and safe-work duties; enforcement activity does not establish asbestos at any sample candidate.
